_about: Made-up symptom descriptions for checking AI-pinion. Each case lists conditions that should appear in the top three, and a keyword that a relevant article title should contain. Add real cases only with the person's agreement, and never commit personal details.

cases.story: My big toe suddenly became very painful, red and hot overnight. It woke me up and it was too sore to put a sock on.
My fingers and toes swell and hurt, mostly on one side. I also have scaly red patches on my elbows and scalp, and some of my fingernails have small pits in them.
My hands and wrists are stiff for more than an hour every morning. The small joints of my fingers swell on both sides, and I feel tired most days.
My thumb, index and middle fingers go numb and tingle. It is worst at night and when I type for a long time, and I sometimes drop things.
I am always tired and feel cold when others do not. I have gained weight without changing how I eat, my skin is dry, and I am constipated most of the time.
I am very tired and get short of breath climbing stairs. I look pale, and my periods have been very heavy for the last few months.
I get a throbbing headache on one side of my head, with feeling sick to my stomach. Bright lights make it worse, and it lasts several hours.
My joints ache in several places, and a red rash across my cheeks gets worse in the sun. I have had sores in my mouth and I am tired all the time.
